name: Small Bowel Adenocarcinoma - FOLFOX/CAPEOX backbone (coverage pointer)

biomarkers.BRAF_V600E: tested (BRAF V600E may be treated with FOLFOX/encorafenib plus cetuximab or panitumumab)
biomarkers.note: The cytotoxic FOLFOX or CAPEOX (capecitabine/oxaliplatin) backbone is not biomarker-restricted; NGS/MMR testing (MMR/MSI, HER2/ERBB2, KRAS, BRAF V600E, NTRK, POLE/POLD1, TMB) guides immunotherapy or targeted add-ons (dMMR/MSI-H -> checkpoint inhibitor; BRAF V600E -> FOLFOX/encorafenib + anti-EGFR). Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Small Bowel Adenocarcinoma, SBA-B and SBA-D.

lineOfTherapy: first-line preferred systemic backbone (FOLFOX or CAPEOX) for locally advanced/unresectable or metastatic small bowel adenocarcinoma; adjuvant FOLFOX/CAPEOX for resected high-risk (e.g., T3/T4, node-positive) disease

eligibilityCriteria.locator: v2.2026, SBA-D (Principles of Systemic Therapy; FOLFOX or CAPEOX preferred)

drugs.name: FOLFOX or CAPEOX backbone (see referenced Standard Protocol - dose not duplicated)

provenance.locator: SBA-D (FOLFOX or CAPEOX preferred); small_bowel lines 357, 418, 477, 537 (locally advanced/metastatic), 590, 595 (adjuvant FOLFOX or CAPEOX 3 to 6 months)

drugs.notes: COVERAGE POINTER - dose intentionally NOT duplicated. Small bowel adenocarcinoma uses the same FOLFOX (fluorouracil/leucovorin/oxaliplatin) or CAPEOX (capecitabine/oxaliplatin) cytotoxic backbone as colorectal adenocarcinoma at the same doses; NCCN SBA v2.2026 (SBA-D) names these regimens but does not print distinct mg/m2 dosing tables. FOLFOX dosing is already modeled in this folder as folfox-4.json, folfox-6.json, and modified-folfox-6.json. dosePerUnit/basis/unit are VERIFY here solely to signal 'resolve by referencing the existing backbone Standard Protocol', not because any dose is unknown. Duodenal high-risk adjuvant FOLFOX/CAPEOX duration is 3 to 6 months (small_bowel lines 590, 595). Fluoropyrimidine DPYD testing per FDA boxed warning (SBA footnote b).

supportiveCare: Systemic dosing and cycle length are defined by the referenced colorectal FOLFOX/CAPEOX Standard Protocols (folfox-4.json / modified-folfox-6.json in this folder); not duplicated here.
Fluoropyrimidine DPYD testing per FDA boxed warning before starting capecitabine or fluorouracil.
dMMR/MSI-H disease: prefer checkpoint-inhibitor immunotherapy (see the dMMR/MSI-H immunotherapy Standard Protocol) over cytotoxic chemotherapy.

monitoring: see the referenced FOLFOX/CAPEOX Standard Protocol for backbone monitoring (CBC, renal, oxaliplatin neuropathy)
biomarker-directed monitoring per any immunotherapy/targeted add-on

core.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
core.locator: Small bowel adenocarcinoma is treated with colorectal-type fluoropyrimidine/oxaliplatin chemotherapy; concrete FOLFOX/CAPEOX dosing is covered by the colorectal backbone Standard Protocols

guideline.locator: SBA-D (Principles of Systemic Therapy; FOLFOX or CAPEOX preferred for locally advanced/metastatic; small_bowel lines 357, 418, 477, 537); adjuvant FOLFOX/CAPEOX 3 to 6 months (small_bowel lines 590, 595); SBA-B (Principles of Pathologic Review, biomarkers; small_bowel lines 199 to 201)

provenanceNote: ONCQIS Standard Protocol COVERAGE POINTER for small bowel adenocarcinoma (disease #27). Per the task, the FOLFOX/CAPEOX backbone is NOT duplicated: NCCN Small Bowel Adenocarcinoma v2.2026 (SBA-D) names FOLFOX or CAPEOX as the preferred systemic regimen (small_bowel lines 357, 418, 477, 537 for locally advanced/metastatic; lines 590, 595 for adjuvant, 3 to 6 months) but prints no distinct mg/m2 dosing - the doses are identical to the colorectal backbone already modeled in this folder as folfox-4.json, folfox-6.json, and modified-folfox-6.json (CAPEOX = capecitabine/oxaliplatin). The single regimen drug entry is a deliberate pointer whose dose fields, cycleLengthDays, and cycles are set to VERIFY and listed in verifyFields to signal 'resolve by referencing the existing colorectal FOLFOX/CAPEOX Standard Protocol', not because any dose is unknown or was inferred. Biomarker testing (MMR/MSI, HER2/ERBB2, KRAS, BRAF V600E) directs immunotherapy/targeted add-ons; fluoropyrimidine DPYD safety noted. No dose was invented or inferred. This remains a StewardMD Standard Protocol; no endorsement implied.
